description: Department of Forest Conservation - Declare that Katugamuwa Demeda Mukalana as Reserved Forest
categorisation: This gazette content involves the declaration of a forest reserve under the Forest Conservation Ordinance, which constitutes a legal/regulatory matter. It contains an official order by the President exercising statutory powers to establish a reserved forest area, complete with legal citations and a detailed schedule describing the boundaries. This fits Type 5 (Legal/Regulatory) as it involves regulatory frameworks, statutory instruments, and legal declarations rather than government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories.
